u0: Idle/normal state: no urgent siren task, no waiting client, no lost food. Current progress is clean. Next objective: keep watching for events. If a client arrives, go to the counter, face the client and toggle to take the order; if the siren starts ringing, head to the siren switch and toggle it off; if food slips from your hands, recover it immediately.
u1: Siren-alert state: the siren is ringing and has not been silenced. The priority objective is to go to the siren switch at the bottom wall, face it and toggle it off to return to normal. A waiting client or a food slip is still relevant: a client arrival or an order-taking action can move you into client handling, and a slip moves you into food recovery, but switch off the siren as soon as practicable and do not serve anyone while it is ringing.
u2: Client-waiting, order-not-taken state: a client is at the counter and their order still needs to be taken. Current progress: client present, no order yet. Next objective: go to the middle counter cell, face the client and toggle to take the order (taking the order requires a client who already arrived). Handle any siren ring or dropped food if it interrupts, but return to take this order.
u3: Order-taken, food-not-prepared state: the client's order is taken but you do not yet have prepared food. Current progress: order recorded. Next objective: if your hands are empty, fetch raw food from the pantry; then, while the client waits with an order taken, face the stove and toggle to prepare the food. If food slips, recover it on the very next move, and silence the siren if it rings.
u4: Prepared-food, serve-pending state: you are carrying prepared (green) food and a waiting client's order is taken. Current progress: order taken and food prepared. Next objective: go to the counter, face the client and toggle to serve, but only while the siren is silent; if the siren is ringing, first go toggle the switch off, and if the food slips, recover it before serving.
u5: Food-recovery state: carried food has just slipped out of your hands and lies on the floor. Current progress: hands are empty and the dropped portion must be retrieved. Next objective: pick it up on your very next move (the slip turns you to face the food), then resume the interrupted work. If the siren rings meanwhile, still prioritize the immediate pickup and then silence the siren.
